name: switchboard
description: Guide the host browser through ride comparisons and validate observed quotes with Switchboard.

interface.longDescription: Experimental Uber and Lyft comparison workflow using the host browser and Switchboard's quote consistency checks. Requires browser access and provider sign-in; does not book rides or compare food orders.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compare Uber and Lyft for one standard ride. Ask for my pickup and destination, then check both live prices and times. Do not book.
